hints.title: Count Total Ones
hints.text: Count the total number of ones in the array. This total k represents the fixed window size.

hints.title: Circular Sliding Window
hints.text: Slide a fixed window of size k across the circular array using modulo indexing.

hints.title: Maximize Existing Ones
hints.text: The minimum swaps equals k minus the maximum count of ones found in any window of size k.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating every grouping by physical permutation or simulation is exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sliding a window over circular indices runs in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that grouping 1s is equivalent to finding the maximum density window of size total_ones.
